paper_metadata.title: A Four-Input Beam-Forming Downconverter for Adaptive Antennas
paper_metadata.abstract: A four-input beam-forming downconverter for adaptive antennas is described. It consists of 2-bit variable gain amplifiers (VGAs), 5-bit local oscillator (LO) signal phase shifters using double RC-bridge circuits, and mixers. The VGAs adjust gain deviation between signal paths. A differential-signal-to-eightphase-signal converter is employed as a part of the LO phase shifter to reduce the chip size. A maximum phase error of 4.1 , which is less than 1 2 LSB, is achieved. This error value indicates that the required phase shifter accuracy and the necessary isolation between the VGAs has been achieved. This beam-forming IC is applicable to receivers with adaptive antennas, and is expected to help to reduce the costs of adaptive antenna systems.
